title: One tool answers whether a head merges clean with main and another head
why: Triage (2026-11-11 08:49 CST) checked #2378 and #1166 against main with `T=$(git merge-tree ... | head -1) && echo clean`, which reads head's exit code, so two conflicted merges read clean. Two builders then hit conflicts their briefs called clean. Harm: wasted lanes and wrong briefs. Fix: a `merge --merge-check <pr> [--with <sha>]` read mode (or a bin script) that prints clean or the conflicted files from merge-tree's own exit, and hand-over briefs cite it.
